statuses.named_open: The provider names this country on its list of where it serves.
statuses.not_named: The provider lists the countries it refuses, and this one isn't on it. That isn't a yes: the provider still decides each application.
statuses.named_closed: The provider names this country on its list of where it won't open.
statuses.absent_from_allowlist: The provider lists where it serves, and this country isn't on it.
statuses.lists_conflict: The provider's own pages put this country on its refusal list and on its supported list.
statuses.needs_us_presence: Open only with a US address or an owner based in the US, wherever you live.
statuses.us_persons_only: Open only to owners with US status. The note says what the provider asks for.
statuses.ofac_only: The provider names no countries. Its terms bar places under US sanctions (OFAC), and let it stop serving other countries at any time without notice.
statuses.unpublished: The provider publishes no rule about where owners live.
statuses.unverified: We couldn't re-read the provider's page, so we don't say.
